import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Survival by passenger class and gender
survival_pclass_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex', 'survived']).size().unstack()
survival_pclass_sex_percentage = survival_pclass_sex.div(survival_pclass_sex.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_pclass_sex_percentage.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax1, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class & Gender', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class\nFemale', '1st Class\nMale', 
                     '2nd Class\nFemale', '2nd Class\nMale',
                     '3rd Class\nFemale', '3rd Class\nMale'], rotation=0)
ax1.legend(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'], title='Survival Status')

# 2. Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
sns.histplot(data=df, x='age', hue='survived', bins=30, kde=True, ax=ax2, 
             palette={0: '#e74c3c', 1: '#2ecc71'}, alpha=0.6)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
ax2.legend(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'], title='Survival Status')

# 3. Survival rate by embarkation port
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
embark_survival = df.groupby('embark_town')['survived'].mean().sort_values()
embark_counts = df['embark_town'].value_counts()

bars = ax3.bar(embark_survival.index, embark_survival.values * 100, 
               color=['#3498db', '#9b59b6', '#f39c12'])
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 100)

# Add count labels on bars
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, embark_counts.loc[embark_survival.index])):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 2,
             f'n={count}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 4. Fare distribution by passenger class and survival
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='pclass', y='fare', hue='survived', ax=ax4, 
            palette={0: '#e74c3c', 1: '#2ecc71'})
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Passenger Class and Survival', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_yscale('log')
ax4.legend(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'], title='Survival Status')
ax4.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])

# 5. Family size vs survival
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
df['family_category'] = pd.cut(df['family_size'], 
                               bins=[0, 1, 4, 11], 
                               labels=['Alone', 'Small Family (2-4)', 'Large Family (5+)'])

ax5 = axes[1, 1]
family_survival = df.groupby('family_category')['survived'].mean().sort_values()
bars_family = ax5.bar(family_survival.index, family_survival.values * 100,
                      color=['#e67e22', '#1abc9c', '#34495e'])
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size Category', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylim(0, 100)

# Add percentage labels on bars
for bar in bars_family:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax5.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 2,
             f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 6. Survival correlation heatmap
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
# Select numerical columns for correlation
numerical_cols = ['survived', 'pclass', 'age', 'sibsp', 'parch', 'fare']
correlation_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()

# Create mask for upper triangle
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(correlation_matrix, dtype=bool))

# Plot heatmap
sns.heatmap(correlation_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm',
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=ax6)
ax6.set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
